resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Joining Tables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Rather than storing the customer name in both tables, the [b]orders [/b]table contains a reference to the [b]customer ID[/b] that appears in the customers table. This approach is more efficient, as opposed to storing the same text values in both tables.
In order to be able to select the corresponding data from both tables, we will need to [b]join [/b]them on that condition.
[note]Tap continue to see how![/note]

content.text:
在客户表**customers** 中存储了客户的`ID`和`Name`，而在订单表**orders**中字段`Customer_ID`也表示了客户的编号，等价于**customers**表中的`ID`字段。


这样**order**表包含了出现在**customers**表中的客户**ID**的引用。相对于在两个表中存储重复的客户信息来说，这种方法更有效率。

为了能够从两个表中查询客户和客户订单的数据，我们使用联合查询**join**。
content.text_html:
Rather than storing the customer name in both tables, the **orders **table contains a reference to the customer ID that appears in the customers table. This approach is more efficient, as opposed to storing the same text values in both tables. In order to be able to select the corresponding data from both tables, we will need to **join **them on that condition.

[s0l0!-header][h1]Joining Tables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

To join the two tables, specify them as a comma-separated list in the FROM clause: [code format="sql" codeId="3063"]SELECT customers.ID, customers.Name, orders.Name, orders.Amount
FROM customers, orders
[b]WHERE customers.ID=orders.Customer_ID
ORDER BY customers.ID;[/b][/code]
[note]Each table contains "ID" and "Name" columns, so in order to select the correct ID and Name, [b]fully qualified names[/b] are used.[/note]
Note that the WHERE clause "joins" the tables on the condition that the [b]ID [/b]from the [b]customers [/b]table should be equal to the [b]customer_ID [/b]of the [b]orders [/b]table.

[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2832" width="100%"]

resolved.title: 学生与导师关联列表
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定两张数据库表：学生表**Students**和教师表**Teachers**，数据如下：

**Students**表:

![](/content/assets/2a6230cc50d7fdeabcfd.jpeg)

**Teachers**表:

![](/content/assets/76c88e045515d6845740.jpeg)

请写一个查询，在一个表中输出所有学生的信息和他们的老师的姓氏(只须`lastname`列)，并按学生ID排序。

最终查询结果包含的列字段为:`id,firstname,lastname,teacher`。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Joining Tables[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given the following [b]students[/b] and [b]teachers[/b] tables
[b]students [/b](with their teachers ID's): [img id="4485" width="100%"]
[b]teachers:[/b][img id="4486" width="100%"]
Write a query to output all of the students with their teachers' last names in one table, sorted by students ID.
[note]The column with teachers' last names should be named "teacher" -- recall the [b]AS[/b] keyword.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 教师姓氏的一列(即`lastname`)应该被命名为"teacher"--记住**AS**关键字。

code_templates.solution_code:
SELECT Students.id, Students.firstname, Students.lastname, Teachers.lastname as teacher
FROM Students,Teachers
WHERE Students.teacherid=Teachers.id
ORDER BY Students.id
